newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kimbry stands for 28 pct of Underground.
newsitem.headline: Kimbry stands for 28 pct of Underground.

text.p: Kimbyr Investments said on Monday it was standing in the market for 7.4 million shares, 28 percent, in Underground Fashions Ltd at 33.5 cents per share.
Merrill Lynch is acting for Kimbyr, a unit of Just Jeans.
The stand is open from January 30 and closes on February 7.

The restricted transfer comprises a proposed conditional purchase of 18,950,000 ordinary shares in Underground Fashions from B E Rissetto, D R Rissetto, B E Rissetto trust and D R Rissetto Trust to Just Jeans.
The offer is subject to review of Underground Fashions store lease arrangements by Just Jeans but this condition has no impact on the price of the proposed transfer.
Underground shares last traded at 28 cents.
